title: Searching narrows the list, Enter moves nobody, no match says so
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers made for this test (a new term holds only this case's customers); one of them is customer B, the last word of whose name is in neither of the other two names.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Type the last word of customer B's name in lower-case letters in "Search customers".
  4. Press Enter.
  5. Replace the search text with "qqqq".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from term A" opens.

Step 3:

  • Only customer B is listed (the match ignores capitals).

Step 4:

  • Nothing is moved: the window stays open and no toast shows.

Step 5:

  • The list area shows "No customers match your search."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R5: “Typing in the search box narrows the list to customers whose name contains the text, ignoring capitals. Pressing Enter in the search box does not move anyone. When nothing matches, the list area shows "No customers match your search."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move Customers search has no match | "No customers match your search." | Inline line in the list area”
